title: Integrated Institutional-Risk Review
purpose: Review ethics, equity, privacy, cybersecurity, safety, continuity, trust, legal, and economic risks as one institutional system.
notes: Synthetic example. Replace all values with authorized local evidence before institutional use.

records.Question and evidence: Are people informed appropriately, able to question consequential use, and offered a human route where required?
Are intended use, limitations, local performance, workflow controls, and fallback acceptable?
Are data, performance, access, outcomes, and burdens assessed across relevant groups?
Are purpose, necessity, minimization, authority, retention, access, and secondary use governed?
Are threat, supplier, integration, logging, incident, downtime, recovery, and continuity controls adequate?
Are evidence, uncertainty, limitations, responsibilities, incidents, and communication credible and accessible?
Are decision rights, review workload, escalation, pause, update, restart, renewal, and retirement authority explicit?
